notes: This is a single-column 1928 Bulgarian natural-history bulletin in the old orthography with Latin taxon names. All random lines, and the long or column-flagged lines (22-24, 26-31, 33-40), read correctly. The column_crossing flags are false: they are ordinary full-width lines. The only recurring fault is the wing-vein notation with subscripts (R₁, r₄, r₅, m₁, R₅): subscripts are dropped and Latin r is read as Cyrillic 'г' (21 'R,', 25 'г.', 32 'г. и т. ... R.', 39 'г'). This affects a handful of lines in the Diptera article; a regex such as '\b[гRт][.,]' in descriptive lines could drop them, but the effect is small.
